reading.title: The Doorbell Button
reading.intro_zh: 这篇短文把 Lesson 59 的“训练一个动作解决旧问题，却制造新循环”换到家里的智能门铃按钮：妹妹从 shouting 变成 pressing，安静了一会儿，又学会用按钮召唤全家。重点练习 doorbell、press、neighbour、complain、let herself in、expert、so that、bad habit、immediately 和 switch off。
passage: Our little sister Emma used to stand outside the playroom and shout. Every time she wanted her blocks, she would shout until someone opened the door. The neighbour next door complained of the noise, so Mum put a small smart doorbell beside the handle. She spent a weekend training Emma to press the blue button so that the door would click open and Emma could let herself in. Emma soon became an expert. However, on Monday she pressed the doorbell from inside the playroom so that someone would come and admire each tower. Since then, she has developed another bad habit. As soon as we answer, she immediately presses it again. Last night Dad switched off the button. The room became quiet, but Emma began sending photos instead.

questions.question: What was Emma's old habit?
options: She stood outside the playroom and shouted until someone opened the door.
She quietly built towers and never asked anyone for help.
She rang the neighbour's doorbell every morning.
She switched off every button in the house.
questions.explanation_zh: 开头说 Emma used to stand outside the playroom and shout，并且会 shout until someone opened the door，这就是旧习惯。

questions.question: Why did Mum train Emma to press the button?
options: Because Emma wanted to learn how to repair a door.
Because the playroom was too bright in the afternoon.
Because the neighbour complained of the shouting noise.
Because Mum wanted Emma to stop building towers.
questions.explanation_zh: 短文说 The neighbour next door complained of the noise，所以妈妈才装按钮并训练 Emma press the blue button。

questions.question: What new skill did Emma learn?
options: She learned to complain politely to the neighbour.
She learned to press the smart doorbell so that she could let herself in.
She learned to switch off the family phone.
She learned to open the front gate with a latch.
questions.explanation_zh: Mum trained Emma to press the blue button，结果 the door would click open and Emma could let herself in。

questions.question: How did the new skill create another problem?
options: Emma forgot where the playroom was.
The neighbour moved away and took the button.
The smart doorbell never worked at all.
Emma pressed the doorbell from inside so that someone would admire each tower.
questions.explanation_zh: 问题反转在 However 后面：Emma 从 playroom 里面按门铃，目的是让别人 come and admire each tower。

questions.question: What happened after Dad switched off the button?
options: Emma immediately stopped building towers forever.
The neighbour came in to fix the playroom.
The room became quiet, but Emma began sending photos instead.
Mum trained Emma to bark at the door.
questions.explanation_zh: 结尾说 Dad switched off the button 之后，The room became quiet, but Emma began sending photos instead，说明按钮循环被打断，但喜剧还留着。

writing.intro_zh: 今天抓五个 Lesson 59 的循环喜剧句式：used to 写旧习惯，Every time...would...until... 写反复发生的动作，spent weeks training...to... 写训练过程，so that...would... 写目的，As soon as...until... 写新循环的顺序。

patterns.title: used to ...
patterns.source: Rex used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
patterns.focus_zh: used to 用来写过去经常发生、现在已经变化的习惯，是 Lesson 59 开头的旧问题。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个人、宠物或设备过去常常做的旧习惯。
patterns.sample: My little sister used to shout outside the playroom door.
patterns.tip_zh: used to 后面接动词原形；它强调 old habit，不要写成 is used to。

patterns.title: Every time ..., ... would ... until ...
patterns.source: Every time he wanted to come into the garden he would bark until someone opened the gate.
patterns.focus_zh: 这个句式把“条件一出现 -> 动作反复发生 -> 到某个结果才停止”的循环写清楚。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写每次某人想进房间、拿东西或求关注时，会一直做某个动作直到别人回应。
patterns.sample: Every time Emma wanted her blocks, she would shout until someone opened the door.
patterns.tip_zh: Every time 后面写触发条件；until 后面写这个动作停止的时间点。

patterns.title: spent weeks training ... to ...
patterns.source: My husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch.
patterns.focus_zh: spent + time + training + object + to do 可以写“花时间训练某人学会一个动作”。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写父母、老师或朋友花时间训练某人按按钮、整理书包或使用一个工具。
patterns.sample: Mum spent a weekend training Emma to press the blue button.
patterns.tip_zh: spent 后面先接时间；training 后面接被训练的人，再用 to do 写学会的动作。

patterns.title: so that ... would ...
patterns.source: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out.
patterns.focus_zh: so that 后面说明目的：做这个动作，是为了让别人做另一件事。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写某人按门铃、发消息或举手，是为了让别人帮忙、回应或过来看看。
patterns.sample: Emma pressed the doorbell so that someone would admire her tower.
patterns.tip_zh: so that 前面写动作；would 后面写别人会做的事，目的关系要清楚。

patterns.title: As soon as ..., ... until ...
patterns.source: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
patterns.focus_zh: As soon as 写“刚一发生”，until 写“等到某个时刻为止”，适合描写循环里的步骤。
patterns.task_zh: 仿写一句：写一个人刚得到回应，就继续等到下一步发生，然后又开始重复。
patterns.sample: As soon as we answered, Emma waited until we looked at the tower.
patterns.tip_zh: As soon as 句首要接一个动作；until 后面接等待结束的信号。
